g.text: GENERAL TOLERANCES ISO 2768-mK. DO NOT SCALE.
ALL DIMENSIONS FROM THE MODEL AS MEASURED.
PROPORTIONS AND MOUNT GEOMETRY FROZEN AT GATE G1
DETAILED MODEL, SEVENTEEN ASSEMBLIES, GATE G2
KNEE ANCHORS, ANKLE PADS, LOOMS REVISED. DRAWING SET ISSUED
96 V NOMINAL LITHIUM-ION PACK, 5.0 kWh, LIQUID COOLED
1. ALL DIMENSIONS IN MILLIMETRES, MEASURED FROM THE MODEL.
2. SHOWN IN THE NEUTRAL STANCE WITH THE MOUNT STOWED, BARREL VERTICAL.
3. HEIGHTS ARE ABOVE GROUND LEVEL TO THE JOINT AXES NAMED.
4. CHAIN LINES MARK JOINT AXES. HAND AXES ARE NOT SHOWN AT THIS SCALE.
5. KNEE FLEXION RANGE 0° TO 110°. SEE SHEET 4.
6. MARKINGS (ASSEMBLY 17) AND HARNESS DETAIL ARE OMITTED FOR CLARITY.
